name: Form Boiler Room (Web)
implementation_notes: The Boiler Room Detail grid is fully dynamic -- addDetailRow()/removeDetailRow()/canAddRow()/availableTimeSlotOptions() on FormBoilerRoom.php, exactly mirroring FormEngineRoom's grid. Grid starts empty on create mode; edit mode loads existing rows verbatim with each row's id

All 15 non-time_slot columns per row are genuinely editable, never disabled -- Boiler Room has no computed detail-grid fields. 2 of them (Blowdown Executed, Sootblowing Executed) render as <select> dropdowns with an empty '-- Pilih --' option (Y/N); 3 of them (Fuel Feed Rate, ID Fan Load, SA Fan Load) render as plain text inputs (mixed/ambiguous paper-form units)

IMPORTANT -- enum empty-string-vs-null: both status dropdowns submit '' when left unselected; BoilerRoomRecordService::normalizeDetails() (shared with screen-098) coerces this to null before validation/persistence, avoiding a SQLite CHECK constraint violation -- verified by dedicated unit tests and a Feature/Api test
UNLIKE Form Threshing Web: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section -- no query, no reference data of any kind
Route /data/boiler-room/create registered BEFORE /data/boiler-room/{id} (screen-108) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}
checked/acknowledged self-attestation checkboxes mirror FormEngineRoom's dual-checkbox pattern (both Checked By AND Acknowledged By)
NoActiveBoilerRoomStationException (mirrors NoActiveEngineRoomStationException) thrown when production_line_id has no active station type=boiler-room

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) spec (backend/tests/Browser/FormBoilerRoomTest.php) exists following this codebase's established convention but could not be executed in this sandboxed environment -- integration (Feature/Api) and component (Feature/Livewire) coverage is complete and passing, consistent with the codebase's Browser/* convention.
